method: Supervisor ordinary CUA keyboard and on-screen mouse inputs. No simulation pose, speed, time, gas or completion writes. Native repeat tests by developer are separate.

cases.name: first-direction
cases.observed: Initial RHS view showed D steering left and high platform on left. Changed rendering to Babylon LHS with glTF conversion root cancelled; real D right turn and platform sides rechecked.

cases.name: low-platform-contact
cases.requestedInputs: R; W3800ms; S1400ms; W+Space1200ms; A1000ms; A+S600ms; S700ms; pause
cases.observed: DOM low/grounded true,0km/h and58 pressure. Resume, stationary ground refill to100, actual teal platform and refill patch visible.
cases.scope: Subsequent second-hop attempts failed and legally recovered to unlocked low checkpoint; supervisor has not claimed a complete manual low-route run. Later C8 repeat also hit a platform side.

cases.name: high-route
cases.requestedInputs: New start; W3800/S1400; W+Space1200; W650; D1000; D+S600; S700; pause. Resume, refill to100; R at unlocked high checkpoint; W+D300; W2500; S1400; pause. Resume; W+D600; W2000.
cases.observed: Actual high/grounded true,0km/h/52 gas. After ground refill and legal checkpoint reset, drove off high platform and glided to actual far/grounded true,0km/h/99 gas. Continued ground drive to complete/far and visible exit panel,68km/h/100 gas.
cases.scope: Individual driving legs used real-time native input; pauses were used to inspect and one R was intentional. Not described as uninterrupted zero-retry play.

failuresAndLimits: Several early low-platform attempts hit sides or failed to reach a safe landing; failures prompted extended landing areas, consistent vehicle footprint, real shadows, height/descent feedback and explicit lift-buffer hint.
Old surfaceId stayed start while driving on runway; this metadata error was fixed. A start attribute alone was not proof of respawn; screenshots and visible reasons were used where available.
Requested native wall-clock hold durations and gaps between CUA calls are not asserted equal to exact simulation-time inputs. Fixed-step diagnostic recipes were not counted as human play.
Old IAB27 became stuck on a connection error page; fresh IAB28 recovered access. No duplicate server was started when strict ports were already occupied.
One browser authority review timed out without an unsafe verdict. The single allowed retry succeeded; there was no approval rejection or bypass.
No physical phone/iOS, independent new-player study, subjective audio quality or performance result is claimed.
